headline.caveat: Blue Owl Real Assets funds' share of the $15B JV is undisclosed

realized_to_date.caveat: not disclosed; construction funding is drawn progressively

nature_md: Funds managed by Blue Owl Capital's Real Assets platform co-sponsor (with Crusoe and Primary Digital Infrastructure) the $15B joint venture that owns the 1.2GW Stargate flagship campus in Abilene, TX — phase 1 (two buildings) from Oct 2024, expanded May 2025 to eight buildings, each able to run up to 50,000 NVIDIA GB200 NVL72s. The JV's equity sits beneath JPMorgan-led construction loans ($2.3B + $7.1B) and above lease income from Oracle, which operates the campus for OpenAI. Blue Owl thereby anchors both of the era's marquee AI SPVs — Meta's Hyperion and OpenAI's Abilene.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Equity investment held in Blue Owl-managed Real Assets funds (client capital; fee-earning AUM). Return profile: development yield on a single-tenant asset chained to Oracle/OpenAI credit.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Member equity of the JV, first-loss beneath ~$9.4B of construction debt.
